#593 · Floating Pokémon

Jellicent

Water Ghost

Unova · Generation 5

Jellicent is a Water/Ghost-type Floating Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5). It stands 2.2 m tall and weighs 135 kg. It evolves from Frillish. Its highest base stat is Sp. Def (105), with a base stat total of 480.
